violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: kitchen equipment and utensil stored on shelf next to cookline with other clean kitchen equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI: CFM placed dirty equipment and utensils at the 3 vat sink to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: pickled radishes stored inside Everest 2 Dr UR refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM placed date mark label on pickled radishes with remaining hold days before discard (2 remaining days).

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the chlorine solution was measured at 200 ppm at the 3 vat sink in the kitchen. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of chlorine sanitizer solution at 100ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CDI: CFM diluted chlorine sanitizer by draining half of the chlorine solution adding water until chlorine sanitizer solution concentration measured 100ppm.

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located (stored on dry storage shelf next to cookline) to prevent contamination of food (dry food items).
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. CDI: CFM relocated employee medication to designated area away from food, single-service items, and food contact surfaces.

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials (multiple boxes of Clorox bleach) is not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food (bulk bag of dry rice and pack of dried mushrooms) on dry storage shelf across from, Turbo Air UR freezer (front kitchen area).
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CDI: CFM relocated jugs of Clorox to area away from food, single-service items, and food contact surfaces.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: In-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: metal utensils (stirring spoons/ scoop) stored in standing water (126F) on stand next to stovetop cookline), multiple plastic bowls (no handle used as scoop stored directly in bulk dry food items (dried black and red beans on shelf across from the Turbo Air UR freezer (front kitchen area).
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM heated up water to 135F to properly stored metal utensils in between use. EHS instructed CFM to monitor container of standing water utensils are stored in between use and ensure the temperature is at least 135F or above. CFM removed plastic bowls from bulk dry products (dry black and red beans)

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: rusted knife and blade x 2 stored oh hanging rack near 3 vat sink in kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. EHS instructed CFM to remove/ discontinue using the rust knife and blades.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard and clear plastic lining dry storage shelves (next to the end of cookline) and cardboard lining shelves in front of the Turbo Air UR freezer (front kitchen).
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS instructed CFM to removed cardboard and clear plastic lining dry storage shelves (end of cookline) and shelves in front of the Turbo Air UR freezer (front kitchen) to allow for proper cleaning.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE FRUIT AND VEGETABLES IN EVEREST 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR (LEFT).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REORGANIZE FOOD DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: SPOON USED TO SERVE RICE IN WATER AT 80F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REPLACED SPOON AND PROVIDED DRY PAN TO STORE RICE SPOON. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. LOVE HAND ADULT DAYCARE CENTER (Inspection Date: 08/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE IN PREPARING SANITIZER SOLUTION IN SANITIZER BUCKET AND TESTING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.
